response.sql: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category), category_average AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(cs.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cs.line_count) AS avg_budget_lines, AVG(cs.line_count - ca.avg_line_count) AS avg_lines_above_category_average FROM category_stats AS cs CROSS JOIN category_average AS ca WHERE cs.line_count > ca.avg_line_count;
